Generative AI

- Google Gemini
- Flux

AI Video & Motion

- Kling
- Veo

Professional Creative Tools

Creative Strategist (French & English), Dubai, on-site

Short is a creative agency specialised in short-form video. We create content and campaigns for brands: performance ads, brand and awareness campaigns, product and venue launches, organic content. We find the idea, write it, shoot it and measure what it does. Our team in France doubles in size every year, and we are now building our Dubai team.
Our Dubai clients are French-speaking founders and international brands, and our core team works in French. Fluent French and fluent English are both mandatory for this role.

The role in one sentence

You own a portfolio of client accounts end to end: you build the creative strategy, produce the concepts and scripts for both performance and brand campaigns, lead the client relationship, and make the client want to renew.

What you will do

Build the creative strategy for each client, whatever the goal: sales, awareness, a brand campaign, a product or venue launch, organic growth.
Produce the creative: concepts, scripts, shooting briefs and iterations, for ads as well as brand and social content.
Read results across channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, organic) and turn them into the next creative decision.
Lead the client: run their meetings, present results, and defend your creative choices.
Manage your batches: keep statuses up to date and deliver concepts and scripts within 3 business days.
Drive renewals: client re-engagement is the number one KPI of our creative team.

You report to Julien, our Head of Creative. On every account you work with a Project Manager, who runs production, and an Account Manager, who handles the commercial side (contract, negotiation, upsell).

What success looks like after 12 months

You run a portfolio of around 10 accounts.
50% or more of your clients renew.
100% of your batches are delivered on time.

Must-haves

Professional or native French and English, written and spoken.
Real experience in creative strategy, content or campaigns, agency or brand side. Show us results: reach, spend, ROAS, launch numbers, volume of content produced.
You can create beyond paid ads: brand campaigns, awareness campaigns, launches, social content.
You have written scripts in volume: ads, social videos, brand films.
At ease with data and ad platforms (Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads Manager): you read results and turn them into a decision.
You use AI tools in your daily workflow.
You can lead a client call on your own and defend a creative choice against the client's opinion.
Based in Dubai (or relocating), and happy to work on-site in a fast, high-volume startup environment.

Nice to have

Accounts spending more than $50,000 per month.
A brand, product or venue launch you led from idea to results.
You have turned around a difficult client situation: an unhappy client won back, or an account relaunched after a drop.
Experience in sectors we work with: real estate, e-commerce, SaaS/apps, hospitality, info products.
Hands-on content skills: directing on set, framing, editing basics.

What does not matter to us

Your degree, or your number of years for its own sake. What matters is that your ideas deliver, whether the goal is sales, awareness or a launch.

What this role is not

It is not a project management role. You will not chase production teams: you think, write, analyse and lead the client.

What we offer

A full-time position in Dubai, on-site with the team, with your UAE work visa sponsored.
Open to freelance profiles too: tell us in your application.
A package defined with you, based on your level.
Real ownership of your accounts in an agency that doubles every year.

Our hiring process (about 2 weeks)

Application review
45-min video interview
Live case study: you get 72 hours to prepare, then present it on a 45-min call
Reference calls
1-hour final interview on-site in Dubai with Clément Vannier, General Manager of Short Dubai
Decision and offer

Apply with Easy Apply and answer the screening questions. Add to your CV or message a link to ads you have scripted or strategised. A short video introduction is a real plus.

— застосунок ШІ-генерованих романтичних історій з з аудиторією 1,5+ млн користувачів по всьому світу. Постер — головне прев'ю кожної історії. У каталозі юзер бачить його в міні-форматі, на майже чорному фоні, і за пару секунд вирішує: відкривати чи скролити далі. Ми масштабуємось і шукаємо людину, яка робитиме цей перший контакт з історією разом із нами.

Працюємо в різних стилях: фотореалізм, фентезі, аніме. Незмінне одне — матеріальність картинки: шкіра, тканина, волосся, поверхні мають бути пропрацьовані, не заплавлені генерацією.

Твоя місія:

Створювати постери, які піднімають CTR історій у каталозі: яскраві, контрастні, з центрованою композицією, що читається в маленькому розмірі на темному фоні.
Доводити AI-генерації до фінальної якості: ретуш, виправлення анатомії й артефактів, Face Swap, світло, кольорокорекція, upscale. Сирі AI-картинки в роботу не йдуть.
Розробляти Title Design і композицію постера так, щоб назва й арт читалися разом
Тримати консистентність героя й локації на основі наданих матеріалів серіалу
Генерувати кілька варіантів і A/B-гіпотез на один постер, обговорювати разом з креативною та продуктовою командою і швидко вносити коригування.

Початковий темп роботи — 3–6 постерів на тиждень.

___________________________________________________________________________

Для цього знадобляться такі навички та досвід:

Просунутий AI-промптинг і генерація (Midjourney, Krea, Higgsfield, Leonardo) — точні промпти під емоцію, композицію, план і кінематографічне світло з перших ітерацій. Уміння витягати фотореалізм із сучасних моделей (Nano Banana, Seedream тощо).
Глибоке володіння Adobe Photoshop — маски, колажування, детальна ретуш, виправлення AI-артефактів і анатомії, Face Swap, кольорокорекція.
Title Design і типографіка — виразні, читабельні назви й текстові плашки, які гармонують із фоновим артом.
Розуміння mobile-first композиції: акцент на емоції обличчя (close-up), контраст, колірні тригери, фокусні точки для швидкого захоплення уваги
Портфоліо з реалістичними постерами або обкладинками. Плюс, якщо в кейсах видно твій пайплайн, а не лише фінальні картинки.
Буде перевагою: 3D (Blender, Daz Studio) для побудови референсних сцен і поз під подальшу генерацію.
Базове володіння Figma — це наш спільний файл-хаб

___________________________________________________________________________

Що отримаєш від нас:

Швидке професійне зростання. Ми будуємо середовище, де розвиток — норма: лекції, бібліотеки, хакатони, школи. Компенсуємо профільне навчання й вивчення будь-якої мови, зокрема української.
Формат роботи на твій вибір. Можеш працювати вдома, в офісі на київському Подолі чи у Львові (генератори, укриття, обіди, снеки — all inclusive), або ж за кордоном — маємо кілька офісів і там.
Техніку та сервіси. Все, що треба для роботи.
Відпочинок. 20 днів відпустки + на офіційні свята та безлімітні лікарняні.
Турботу про тіло та менталку. Компенсуємо спорт, медстрахування в Україні (після випробувального), послуги корпоративного лікаря і підтримку ментального здоров’я&

___________________________________________________________________________

Чому з нами класно?

Реальний вплив. Твої рішення впливають на 100+ млн користувачів — їхній досвід, емоції та час, який вони проводять у продукті.
Жива культура. Ми створюємо середовище, де можна експериментувати й пробувати щось нове. Середня оцінка відповіді на питання «Наскільки тобі подобається працювати в HOLYWATER?» за результатами eNPS — 9,23/10.
Автономність. Ми довіряємо рішенням команди: мінімум мікроменеджменту, максимум простору для ініціативи й впливу.
Сильні люди поруч. Ми постійно челенджимо статус-кво та досягаємо нових вершин. Думати інакше й прагнути більшого — тут це підтримають.

Можливо, це — твій шанс стати нашим наступним big name?

Відгукнися на вакансію! Надішли портфоліо й коротко опиши, як ти працюєш із генерацією і постобробкою. Далі — тестове: два постери за двома брифами, з референсами персонажів і локацій від нас. Потім співбесіда з командою.

Job Purpose

We are looking for a Lead Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team and play a key role in shaping how we invest, measure and maximise the impact of our paid media spend.

As a Lead Digital Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of Ounass's cross-channel paid media investment strategy, ensuring our marketing budgets are allocated effectively to drive sustainable growth, customer acquisition and commercial performance.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you will be responsible for defining budget allocation frameworks, establishing measurement standards, leading incrementality testing and owning the paid media forecast across our six GCC markets.

Working closely with our Paid Search, Paid Social, Influencer Marketing and other channel leads, you will set the investment direction, performance expectations and measurement frameworks that guide their execution.

This is a highly analytical and commercially focused role requiring someone who can translate complex marketing data into clear investment decisions, challenge existing measurement approaches and confidently present recommendations to senior leadership and Finance.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Investment & Budget Allocation

Own and manage the cross-channel paid media budget across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, Affiliates and Influencer Marketing, covering the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain.
Define investment allocation frameworks, marginal efficiency targets, growth expectations and customer acquisition cost (CAC) thresholds to guide channel-level decisions.
Lead the budget reallocation process through weekly pacing reviews, monthly investment rebalancing and quarterly resets aligned with business forecasts.
Analyse channel and market performance to identify opportunities to optimise investment, improve returns and support business growth.
Partner with Finance and Retail Media to distinguish brand-funded investment from Ounass-funded spend, ensuring accurate reporting of Net DM.
Balance short-term performance efficiency with longer-term upper-funnel investment, assessing the commercial impact, expected returns and payback periods.
Apply marginal economics and diminishing-returns analysis to inform investment decisions across performance marketing channels.

Marketing Measurement & Incrementality

Establish and own the measurement framework used to evaluate paid media performance and guide budget allocation decisions.
Lead the incrementality testing programme across key marketing channels, including geo holdout experiments, conversion lift studies and other testing methodologies.
Partner with BI and Data teams to design experiments, interpret results and translate findings into actionable investment recommendations.
Own the application and interpretation of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) insights, identifying opportunities to improve channel allocation and overall marketing effectiveness.
Bring together insights from platform attribution, GA4, app measurement platforms such as Adjust, and MMM to create a consistent view of marketing performance.
Develop and interpret diminishing-returns curves across channels and markets to understand where additional investment generates incremental value.
Work with Technology, BI and Data teams to ensure measurement accuracy across server-side tracking, consent management, app attribution and SKAdNetwork.
Challenge attribution discrepancies and investigate data quality issues that could affect investment decisions.

Forecasting & Strategic Planning

Own the weekly, monthly and annual paid media forecasts across channels and markets, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
Lead the paid media planning process, providing accurate investment assumptions and performance projections for annual budgets and business reforecasts.
Build investment scenarios that demonstrate the commercial impact of increasing, reducing or reallocating marketing budgets.
Work with channel leads to establish market and channel-level performance targets aligned with overall business objectives.
Partner closely with Finance to ensure marketing forecasts are commercially sound, measurable and aligned with business planning.
Present and defend investment recommendations, forecasts and assumptions to senior leadership.

Performance Reporting & Commercial Insights

Own the paid media performance narrative for the VP Marketing, Finance and other key stakeholders, clearly communicating performance drivers, risks and recommended actions.
Partner with BI to develop a consistent source of truth for marketing performance reporting, reducing fragmented reporting and ensuring alignment across teams.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that support investment and commercial decisions.
Provide category-level and brand-level investment insights to Commercial and Retail Media teams.
Support key trading moments, including Ramadan, Eid, private sales and peak trading periods, through investment planning, performance analysis and forecasting.
Develop concise, decision-focused reporting that allows leadership and channel teams to act quickly and confidently.

AI, Automation & Marketing Effectiveness

Identify opportunities to automate performance reporting, budget pacing alerts, forecasting and investment allocation recommendations.
Use AI and automation tools to improve analytical efficiency, streamline workflows and reduce manual reporting.
Establish appropriate guardrails and measurement frameworks for platform-led automation, assessing performance against manual approaches.
Continuously explore emerging technologies, analytical tools and measurement methodologies to improve marketing effectiveness.
Measure and demonstrate the efficiency gains achieved through AI and automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Work closely with channel leads, Finance, BI, Data, Growth, Commercial and Retail Media teams to ensure alignment on investment priorities and performance expectations.
Manage and coordinate measurement initiatives involving Marketing Mix Modelling, lift studies and external marketing platform measurement teams.
Establish and document clear standards for budget allocation, experiment design, forecasting and reporting.
Ensure marketing investment decisions remain aligned with Ounass's luxury positioning, brand standards and long-term business objectives.
Challenge investment opportunities or placements that may deliver short-term efficiency but compromise brand perception.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

8+ years of experience in performance marketing, with proven ownership of significant multi-channel paid media budgets, ideally within a scaled e-commerce or consumer business.
Strong experience developing cross-channel investment strategies, allocating budgets across markets and demonstrating measurable commercial returns.
Proven hands-on experience designing, evaluating and acting on incrementality studies, including geo holdouts and conversion lift experiments.
Experience working with Marketing Mix Models (MMM), interpreting model outputs, challenging assumptions and translating findings into investment decisions.
Demonstrated ownership of marketing forecasts, with accountability for forecast accuracy and commercial performance.
Strong analytical capabilities, including proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of statistical testing, sample size, statistical power, significance and experiment design.
Working knowledge of GA4, mobile measurement platforms such as Adjust or AppsFlyer, including SKAdNetwork, and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta at scale, alongside a strong understanding of Snapchat and TikTok advertising platforms.
Ability to challenge channel-level bidding strategies, campaign structures, attribution methodologies and optimisation approaches.
Experience managing investment across multiple markets, ideally including KSA and UAE, with exposure to both web and app performance.
Strong commercial understanding of key marketing and business metrics, including GMV, CAC, customer lifetime value (CLV), contribution margin, marginal returns and payback periods.
Experience partnering with Finance, Commercial, BI and Data teams to support investment decisions and business planning.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate analysis and deliver measurable efficiencies.
A degree in Marketing, Economics, Statistics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

Experience within luxury, fashion, beauty or premium e-commerce, particularly across GCC markets.
Arabic language skills and a strong understanding of UAE and KSA consumer behaviour.
Proficiency in Python or R, alongside exposure to modern data environments such as dbt, Athena or BigQuery.

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.
Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.
Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.
Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.

Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

You own a portfolio of client accounts end to end: you build the creative strategy, produce the concepts and scripts for both performance and brand campaigns, lead the client relationship, and make the client want to renew.

Build the creative strategy for each client, whatever the goal: sales, awareness, a brand campaign, a product or venue launch, organic growth.
Produce the creative: concepts, scripts, shooting briefs and iterations, for ads as well as brand and social content.
Read results across channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, organic) and turn them into the next creative decision.
Lead the client: run their meetings, present results, and defend your creative choices.
Manage your batches: keep statuses up to date and deliver concepts and scripts within 3 business days.
Drive renewals: client re-engagement is the number one KPI of our creative team.

You report to Julien, our Head of Creative. On every account you work with a Project Manager, who runs production, and an Account Manager, who handles the commercial side (contract, negotiation, upsell).

You run a portfolio of around 10 accounts.
50% or more of your clients renew.

Professional or native French and English, written and spoken.
Real experience in creative strategy, content or campaigns, agency or brand side. Show us results: reach, spend, ROAS, launch numbers, volume of content produced.
You can create beyond paid ads: brand campaigns, awareness campaigns, launches, social content.
You have written scripts in volume: ads, social videos, brand films.
At ease with data and ad platforms (Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads Manager): you read results and turn them into a decision.

Accounts spending more than $50,000 per month.
A brand, product or venue launch you led from idea to results.

Your degree, or your number of years for its own sake. What matters is that your ideas deliver, whether the goal is sales, awareness or a launch.

It is not a project management role. You will not chase production teams: you think, write, analyse and lead the client.

Job Purpose

We are looking for a Lead Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team and play a key role in shaping how we invest, measure and maximise the impact of our paid media spend.

As a Lead Digital Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of Ounass's cross-channel paid media investment strategy, ensuring our marketing budgets are allocated effectively to drive sustainable growth, customer acquisition and commercial performance.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you will be responsible for defining budget allocation frameworks, establishing measurement standards, leading incrementality testing and owning the paid media forecast across our six GCC markets.

Working closely with our Paid Search, Paid Social, Influencer Marketing and other channel leads, you will set the investment direction, performance expectations and measurement frameworks that guide their execution.

This is a highly analytical and commercially focused role requiring someone who can translate complex marketing data into clear investment decisions, challenge existing measurement approaches and confidently present recommendations to senior leadership and Finance.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Media Investment & Budget Allocation

Own and manage the cross-channel paid media budget across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, Affiliates and Influencer Marketing, covering the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain.
Define investment allocation frameworks, marginal efficiency targets, growth expectations and customer acquisition cost (CAC) thresholds to guide channel-level decisions.
Lead the budget reallocation process through weekly pacing reviews, monthly investment rebalancing and quarterly resets aligned with business forecasts.
Analyse channel and market performance to identify opportunities to optimise investment, improve returns and support business growth.
Partner with Finance and Retail Media to distinguish brand-funded investment from Ounass-funded spend, ensuring accurate reporting of Net DM.
Balance short-term performance efficiency with longer-term upper-funnel investment, assessing the commercial impact, expected returns and payback periods.
Apply marginal economics and diminishing-returns analysis to inform investment decisions across performance marketing channels.

Marketing Measurement & Incrementality

Establish and own the measurement framework used to evaluate paid media performance and guide budget allocation decisions.
Lead the incrementality testing programme across key marketing channels, including geo holdout experiments, conversion lift studies and other testing methodologies.
Partner with BI and Data teams to design experiments, interpret results and translate findings into actionable investment recommendations.
Own the application and interpretation of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) insights, identifying opportunities to improve channel allocation and overall marketing effectiveness.
Bring together insights from platform attribution, GA4, app measurement platforms such as Adjust, and MMM to create a consistent view of marketing performance.
Develop and interpret diminishing-returns curves across channels and markets to understand where additional investment generates incremental value.
Work with Technology, BI and Data teams to ensure measurement accuracy across server-side tracking, consent management, app attribution and SKAdNetwork.
Challenge attribution discrepancies and investigate data quality issues that could affect investment decisions.

Forecasting & Strategic Planning

Own the weekly, monthly and annual paid media forecasts across channels and markets, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
Lead the paid media planning process, providing accurate investment assumptions and performance projections for annual budgets and business reforecasts.
Build investment scenarios that demonstrate the commercial impact of increasing, reducing or reallocating marketing budgets.
Work with channel leads to establish market and channel-level performance targets aligned with overall business objectives.
Partner closely with Finance to ensure marketing forecasts are commercially sound, measurable and aligned with business planning.
Present and defend investment recommendations, forecasts and assumptions to senior leadership.

Performance Reporting & Commercial Insights

Own the paid media performance narrative for the VP Marketing, Finance and other key stakeholders, clearly communicating performance drivers, risks and recommended actions.
Partner with BI to develop a consistent source of truth for marketing performance reporting, reducing fragmented reporting and ensuring alignment across teams.
Translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that support investment and commercial decisions.
Provide category-level and brand-level investment insights to Commercial and Retail Media teams.
Support key trading moments, including Ramadan, Eid, private sales and peak trading periods, through investment planning, performance analysis and forecasting.
Develop concise, decision-focused reporting that allows leadership and channel teams to act quickly and confidently.

AI, Automation & Marketing Effectiveness

Identify opportunities to automate performance reporting, budget pacing alerts, forecasting and investment allocation recommendations.
Use AI and automation tools to improve analytical efficiency, streamline workflows and reduce manual reporting.
Establish appropriate guardrails and measurement frameworks for platform-led automation, assessing performance against manual approaches.
Continuously explore emerging technologies, analytical tools and measurement methodologies to improve marketing effectiveness.
Measure and demonstrate the efficiency gains achieved through AI and automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Work closely with channel leads, Finance, BI, Data, Growth, Commercial and Retail Media teams to ensure alignment on investment priorities and performance expectations.
Manage and coordinate measurement initiatives involving Marketing Mix Modelling, lift studies and external marketing platform measurement teams.
Establish and document clear standards for budget allocation, experiment design, forecasting and reporting.
Ensure marketing investment decisions remain aligned with Ounass's luxury positioning, brand standards and long-term business objectives.
Challenge investment opportunities or placements that may deliver short-term efficiency but compromise brand perception.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

8+ years of experience in performance marketing, with proven ownership of significant multi-channel paid media budgets, ideally within a scaled e-commerce or consumer business.
Strong experience developing cross-channel investment strategies, allocating budgets across markets and demonstrating measurable commercial returns.
Proven hands-on experience designing, evaluating and acting on incrementality studies, including geo holdouts and conversion lift experiments.
Experience working with Marketing Mix Models (MMM), interpreting model outputs, challenging assumptions and translating findings into investment decisions.
Demonstrated ownership of marketing forecasts, with accountability for forecast accuracy and commercial performance.
Strong analytical capabilities, including proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of statistical testing, sample size, statistical power, significance and experiment design.
Working knowledge of GA4, mobile measurement platforms such as Adjust or AppsFlyer, including SKAdNetwork, and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta at scale, alongside a strong understanding of Snapchat and TikTok advertising platforms.
Ability to challenge channel-level bidding strategies, campaign structures, attribution methodologies and optimisation approaches.
Experience managing investment across multiple markets, ideally including KSA and UAE, with exposure to both web and app performance.
Strong commercial understanding of key marketing and business metrics, including GMV, CAC, customer lifetime value (CLV), contribution margin, marginal returns and payback periods.
Experience partnering with Finance, Commercial, BI and Data teams to support investment decisions and business planning.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate analysis and deliver measurable efficiencies.
A degree in Marketing, Economics, Statistics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

Experience within luxury, fashion, beauty or premium e-commerce, particularly across GCC markets.
Arabic language skills and a strong understanding of UAE and KSA consumer behaviour.
Proficiency in Python or R, alongside exposure to modern data environments such as dbt, Athena or BigQuery.
Experience building dashboards and analytical reporting solutions in Tableau, Looker or Looker Studio.
Experience preparing structured investment recommendations and decision documents for senior leadership.
Exposure to brand-funded marketing, co-op investment, Retail Media or partner-funded advertising, including reporting and commercial accountability.

We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations

Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR
